title: Gate Evidence
description: Structured evidence returned by every phase-gate evaluation, as ratified by core/ADR-0073. This is the canonical `data` payload for gate evaluation across CLI, MCP, and REST surfaces.

gateId.description: Stable identifier of the evaluated gate (e.g. 'design-baseline-approved').

phase.description: SDLC phase the gate belongs to.

verdict.description: Evaluation outcome. 'failed' is mandatory when any violation has severity 'error'.

rulesetRef.description: Reference to the Evolith Core ruleset evaluated (e.g. 'rulesets/sdlc/phase-gates.rules.json').

rulesetVersion.description: Version of the referenced ruleset at evaluation time, taken from its 'version' field.

violations.description: Every rule violation found. Empty array when the gate passes cleanly.

ruleId.description: Identifier of the violated rule within the referenced ruleset.

location.description: Where the violation was found (file path, artifact name, or logical location).

message.description: Actionable human-readable explanation of the violation.

evaluatedBy.description: Actor class that triggered the evaluation.
